files.README.md:
# pg-332: Utilities and gutters ignore a runtime --spacer-3 or --radius-5 override

Overriding --spacer-3 or --radius-5 in tokens.css moves the components but not .p-3, .gap-3, .g-3 or .rounded, which write the $spacers and $radii values at compile time.

Bootstrap main at 2f63a73 (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/commit/2f63a737635d9c8daea42bb5509f4fe81c0e6789), compiled from its source with this reproduction's config: `main.scss` (Sass options), `_custom.scss` (Sass rules) and `tokens.css` (CSS custom properties and rules).

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Exported from https://github.com/julien-deramond/bootstrap-test-playground/tree/main/issues/pg-332
